owner: Mika under owner-requested mobile camera QR feature
purpose: Reusable phone camera QR input for fixed mobile request screens, local decoding and explicit confirmation, not business dispatch.
publication_policy: Parent sole publisher, isolated worker, independent review and exact-head/base CI
sql_policy: No SQL/customer data or business operations; camera hardware not activated during implementation tests.
constraints: Eight app paths plus new checkpoint only; immutable admission marker unchanged; no request-editor/workspace/nav/API/BFF changes
next.config.ts only change camera permissions policy from none to same-origin self for owner-requested scanner; retain microphone/geolocation and all other security constraints
Exact jsqr1.4.0 dependency from official reputable package source, lockfile updated normally; no unrelated package upgrades, CDN or native detector requirement
Explicit user Start only; audio false, preferred rear camera, playsInline/muted preview; no actual device-camera activation in author/reviewer tests
Decode frames locally with bounded frame size/rate/text length; never upload/store/log image frames or decoded payload
Stop all tracks on detection, close, unmount, background/pagehide and session change, including late-acquired streams; foreground requires fresh Start
Deduplicate detections and require explicit confirmation; decoded text is untrusted escaped input, never automatic URL navigation, SQL, API dispatch or business save/submit
Caller owns scope key and field-specific validation; cancel/fence stale async responses across scope changes
Clear denied/unavailable/insecure/unsupported errors and manual entry fallback; accessible mobile focus/touch and safe close lifecycle
Offline fake-camera lifecycle tests, real local decoder synthetic QR fixtures and actual component/browser interactions; distinguish Node24/native Android/iOS camera proof not run
No OS/browser camera permission grants, global certificate/security/IIS/service changes, secret access, privacy policy weakening beyond same-origin camera feature
Preserve all existing claimed paths/worktrees, no source payload transfer or publication before independent review
